merchant/30148.htm.text: Trader Ariel: We sell exquisite armor, sturdy shields and elegant helms. All are guaranteed to work as good as they look!

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30148-1.htm.text: Trader Ariel: What would you like to do?

merchant/30148-pk.htm.text: Trader Ariel: Your lips are smiling, but your eyes tell me all -- about the dark nature you carry in your heart. Please leave at once. I do not wish to trade with the likes of you.

Q00007_ATripBegins/30148-01.html.text: Trader Ariel: You don't look like you're here to browse. Is it because you think you're ready to venture into the outside world? Heh ... perhaps you are. Some might disagree with me, but I've come to accept that it's natural for a young elf such as yourself to want more than the protection of the M…

Q00007_ATripBegins/30148-03.html.text: Trader Ariel: Do you have that Recommendation letter I wrote for you? Take it to Hierarch Asterios , I'm sure he'll sponsor you!
